import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.codex/skills/docx')

from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document('unpacked_quarterly', rsid="0CB3C83B")

# Locate the last content paragraph (end of RISK FACTORS section)
last_para = doc["word/document.xml"].get_node(
    tag="w:p", contains="Key risks include potential currency fluctuations"
)

rpr = ('<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" '
       'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>')

def para(text=""):
    return (f'<w:p><w:pPr/><w:r>{rpr}'
            f'<w:t xml:space="preserve">{text}</w:t></w:r></w:p>')

new_section = (
    para() +  # spacer after RISK FACTORS content
    para("RECOMMENDATIONS") +
    para() +
    para("• Invest in cloud infrastructure and go-to-market resources to capitalize on the 22.8% growth in the Cloud Services segment.") +
    para("• Maintain cost discipline and operational efficiency programs to sustain operating margins above 23%.") +
    para("• Prioritize international market expansion and new product launches to support the 10-13% revenue growth outlook for Q1 2025.") +
    para("• Continue optimizing marketing spend to further reduce customer acquisition costs while growing customer lifetime value.")
)

doc["word/document.xml"].insert_after(last_para, new_section)
doc.save()
print("Recommendations section added and saved.")
EOF
